title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_9
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing correspondence, internal memoranda, and reports regarding UFO sightings and the activities of civilian UFO research organizations between 1957 and 1960. / This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing investigative records, correspondence, and teletypes regarding UFO sightings and public inquiries from 1947 to 1966.

incidents.summary: Two individuals reported seeing a flying disc in the shape of a man's hat hovering over Matahambre, Cuba, before it disappeared at high speed toward the sea.
An unknown object described as looking like the moon and trailing a pulsing blue flame was reported in Vernal, Utah.
A woman reported seeing a flying saucer hovering over her farm in Michigan, which she believed was piloted by outer space visitors who took newspapers and magazines.
incidents.shape: dome shaped like an eskimo hut

incidents.summary: A report of an unidentified flying object near Torrington, Connecticut.
Joseph Perry observed an unidentified flying object in a photograph he took of the moon.
George W. Van Tassel gave a lecture at Phipps Auditorium in Denver, Colorado, discussing UFOs, religious-economic theories, and claims of contact with space people.
incidents.location_name: Phipps Auditorium, City Park, Denver, Colorado
incidents.quote: The program consisted of a 45 minute movie which included several shots of things purported to be flying saucers

incidents.summary: Joseph Perry of Grand Blanc, Michigan, claimed a photograph of the moon contained a flying object. The Air Force stated it was a development error.
incidents.quote: what appears to be a flying object in this slide is actually a part of the negative which was not properly developed

incidents.summary: Leonard H. Stringfield received an anonymous phone call warning of a flurry of UFO sightings between October 15 and 19, 1961, linked to Russian nuclear tests.
incidents.quote: Mark these dates, October 15 to October 19, during which will be the greatest incident in UFO (Unidentified Flying Objects) activity over the years

incidents.summary: Lonnie Zamora, a Socorro police officer, observed a landed oval-shaped object with two occupants in white coveralls, which then took off with a roar and flames.
incidents.quote: ZAMORA STATES OBJECT WAS OVAL SHAPED, SIMILAR TO FOOTBALL, POSSIBLY TWENTY FEET LONG

incidents.summary: Orlando Gallegos observed a butane-tank-shaped object at La Maderia, New Mexico, surrounded by a blue-white flame.
incidents.quote: SOMETHING SHAPED LIKE A BUTANE TANK, POSSIBLY TWELVE TO FOURTEEN FEET HIGH
